Card Q&A.a: You can use this card, but unless you place both [ExVeemon] and [Stingmon] at the bottom of your deck from your hand, you can't use this card's effect to play a [Paildramon] from your hand without paying its memory cost.You also can't use this card to place only [ExVeemon] or [ExVeemon] at the bottom of your deck from your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If I only have either [ExVeemon] or [Stingmon] in my hand, can I use this card?

Effect: [Main] If you have [Davis Motomiya] and [Ken Ichijoji] in play, you may place 1 [ExVeemon] and 1 [Stingmon] from your hand at the bottom of your deck in any order to play 1 [Paildramon] from your hand without paying its memory cost.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to your hand.
